CITY OF SAN MARINO
  CITY COUNCIL
  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  HOUSING ELEMENT COMMUNITY CONVERSATION

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of San Marino will hold a 6th Cycle Housing Element Update:
Community Conversation on April 23, 2024, at 6:00 P.M., at the San Marino Community Center,
1800 Huntington Drive, San Marino, CA 91108.

It is intended that this will be a City staff/consultant-run meeting and the discussion will focus on the 6th
Cycle Housing Element Update. However, due to the possibility that three (3) or more members of the
San Marino City Council may attend this meeting, which will include a discussion on the Housing
Element, and the solicitation of public input on the Housing Element, notice of a special meeting of the
San Marino City Council is hereby given in an abundance of caution pursuant to Section 54956 of the
Government Code of the State of California.

Residents and members of the public are encouraged to learn more about the Housing Element Update
process. Information about the Housing Element Update process can be found here:
https://sanmarinoca.gov/government/departments/community_development/2021-
2029_housing_element.php

If you are unable to attend and would still like to provide input or speak to staff about this important
topic, please contact Isidro Figueroa, Community Development Director by email at
iFigueroa@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626) 300-0710.

  By:  Alison Walker
  City Clerk
Date: April 22, 2024
Publish: April 22, 2024
Notice No.: N-24-05
